safety_policy.zero_human_hazard_rule: NO human being shall enter the dynamic vehicle travel envelope, stopping buffer, or secondary diversion corridor during testing under any circumstances.
safety_policy.actor_substitutes: All primary and secondary pedestrian interactions MUST be executed using certified test dummies, foam mannequins on remote rail/pulley actuators, or soft automated guided targets.
safety_policy.e_stop_mandate: Dual remote wireless SIL-3 E-Stops active with Safety Marshal having sole uninhibited line-of-sight abort authority.

causality_disclaimer: The pairing of RUN_BASELINE and RUN_INTERVENTION provides a controlled contrastive observation only; it DOES NOT prove universal counterfactual causality due to potential unobserved environmental covariates.

scenarios.objective: Verify primary intervention where vehicle executes full in-lane deceleration without diversion or secondary exposure.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Braking to full stop at >= 3.0 m from target

run_baseline.description: Vehicle operates straight path at nominal speed (3.0 m/s) with no obstacle present.

run_intervention.description: Mannequin introduced at 15m; automated/manual brake triggers deceleration; stops in lane.

scenarios.objective: Vehicle continues nominal trajectory through corridor with stationary obstacles outside clearance envelope.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Constant velocity pass through corridor without evasive maneuver

run_intervention.description: Cones placed at 1.8m lateral offset; vehicle passes without deceleration or swerving.

scenarios.objective: Vehicle swerves laterally to avoid primary obstacle, entering secondary cross-aisle where observability is confirmed and verified completely empty.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Lateral swerve (steering angle > 12 deg) into cross-aisle mouth to bypass primary obstacle

run_intervention.description: Primary obstacle induces steering diversion; vehicle enters cross-aisle; Camera C confirms zero actors in zone.

scenarios.scenario_name: Controlled Secondary Exposure Using Safe Proxy
scenarios.objective: Simulate backfire kinetic chain safely: vehicle swerves to avoid primary dummy, and trajectory directly intersects a secondary robotic foam dummy in cross-aisle within tau <= 2.0s.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Evasive steering into cross-aisle intersecting P2's designated position

run_baseline.description: Vehicle stops straight behind P1 without swerving; P2 remains static in cross-aisle.

run_intervention.description: Vehicle executes swerve around P1; vehicle path vector passes within 0.8m of P2 within 1.4s of swerve onset.

scenarios.objective: Test separation between vehicle-induced risk and an uncoordinated, independent actor approaching from another direction.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Braking for P1; independent trolley moves across background on separate unconflicted trajectory

run_baseline.description: Motorized trolley passes at constant speed 1.0 m/s with vehicle stationary.

run_intervention.description: Vehicle decelerates for P1; trolley passes at 6m distance unaffected by vehicle maneuver.

scenarios.objective: Stress optical tracking identity preservation as vehicle and actors transition between Camera A, Camera B, and Camera C.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Navigating diagonally through intersection overlapping camera FOVs

run_baseline.description: Empty junction transit tracking vehicle only across camera boundaries.

run_intervention.description: Vehicle and mobile dummy cross optical overlap zones simultaneously; test ID switch detection.

scenarios.objective: Evaluate system evidence pipeline when secondary zone has intentional physical obstruction (blind pocket).
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Swerve diversion toward partially occluded cross-aisle

run_baseline.description: Baseline view of pallet obstruction with Secondary Observability = FALSE.

run_intervention.description: Swerve occurs; Secondary Observability remains FALSE; Gate E4 must reject candidate for insufficient observability.

scenarios.objective: Inject synthetic hardware dropout (e.g. disconnect Camera C feed or inject CAN timeout) to verify instant Gate rejection and abort trigger.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Braking run with forced sensor stream cutoff at t=2.0s

run_baseline.description: Normal multi-modal capture without failure injection.

run_intervention.description: Camera C RTSP packet drop forced during vehicle deceleration; Gate D2 must FAIL immediately.

scenarios.objective: Inject timestamp perturbation (> 5.0 ms component limit or > 33.3 ms composite skew) to verify Gate C1 / D2 rejection.
scenarios.vehicle_nominal_action: Nominal stop run with CAN gateway clock desynchronized by +25.0 ms

run_intervention.description: CAN timestamp perturbed by +25.0 ms; exceeds 10.0 ms component budget; Gate C1 / D2 must FAIL even if within composite frame.
